# JibonFlow Multi-AZ Deployment Topology

**Generated by**: Orchestrator Agent → Architecture Agent Handoff  
**Date**: 2025-10-11  
**Status**: Ready for Implementation  
**Priority**: High (Production Readiness)  
**Compliance**: HIPAA § 164.308(a)(7), AWS Well-Architected Framework

---

## 1. Executive Summary

This specification defines the highly available, fault-tolerant AWS Multi-AZ deployment architecture for JibonFlow's production environment. The design ensures 99.95% uptime SLA, automatic failover, and disaster recovery capabilities for healthcare-critical workloads.

**Key Objectives**:

- ✅ 99.95% uptime SLA (maximum 4.4 hours downtime/year)
- ✅ Automatic failover across Availability Zones (AZs)
- ✅ Zero data loss during AZ failures (RPO = 0)
- ✅ <60 second recovery time (RTO = 60s)
- ✅ HIPAA-compliant disaster recovery (backup & restore)

## 3. Network Architecture (VPC Design)

### 3.1 VPC Configuration

```typescript
// infra/terraform/vpc.tf
resource "aws_vpc" "jibonflow_production" {
  cidr_block           = "10.0.0.0/16"
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
  enable_dns_support   = true
  
  tags = {
    Name        = "jibonflow-production-vpc"
    Environment = "production"
    ManagedBy   = "terraform"
  }
}

// Availability Zones
variable "availability_zones" {
  default = ["ap-southeast-1a", "ap-southeast-1b"]
}

// Public Subnets (for ALB, NAT Gateway)
resource "aws_subnet" "public" {
  count                   = 2
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.jibonflow_production.id
  cidr_block              = "10.0.${count.index + 1}.0/24"
  availability_zone       = var.availability_zones[count.index]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true
  
  tags = {
    Name = "jibonflow-public-${var.availability_zones[count.index]}"
    Type = "Public"
  }
}

// Private Subnets (for ECS Fargate)
resource "aws_subnet" "private" {
  count             = 2
  vpc_id            = aws_vpc.jibonflow_production.id
  cidr_block        = "10.0.${count.index + 11}.0/24"
  availability_zone = var.availability_zones[count.index]
  
  tags = {
    Name = "jibonflow-private-${var.availability_zones[count.index]}"
    Type = "Private"
  }
}

// Data Subnets (for RDS, ElastiCache - isolated)
resource "aws_subnet" "data" {
  count             = 2
  vpc_id            = aws_vpc.jibonflow_production.id
  cidr_block        = "10.0.${count.index + 21}.0/24"
  availability_zone = var.availability_zones[count.index]
  
  tags = {
    Name = "jibonflow-data-${var.availability_zones[count.index]}"
    Type = "Data"
  }
}

// Internet Gateway (for public subnets)
resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.jibonflow_production.id
  
  tags = {
    Name = "jibonflow-igw"
  }
}

// NAT Gateways (one per AZ for redundancy)
resource "aws_eip" "nat" {
  count  = 2
  domain = "vpc"
  
  tags = {
    Name = "jibonflow-nat-eip-${var.availability_zones[count.index]}"
  }
}

resource "aws_nat_gateway" "main" {
  count         = 2
  allocation_id = aws_eip.nat[count.index].id
  subnet_id     = aws_subnet.public[count.index].id
  
  tags = {
    Name = "jibonflow-nat-${var.availability_zones[count.index]}"
  }
}
```

### 3.2 Security Groups

```typescript
// Application Load Balancer Security Group
resource "aws_security_group" "alb" {
  name        = "jibonflow-alb-sg"
  description = "Allow HTTPS traffic to ALB"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.jibonflow_production.id
  
  ingress {
    from_port   = 443
    to_port     = 443
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
    description = "HTTPS from internet"
  }
  
  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

// ECS Tasks Security Group
resource "aws_security_group" "ecs_tasks" {
  name        = "jibonflow-ecs-tasks-sg"
  description = "Allow traffic from ALB to ECS tasks"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.jibonflow_production.id
  
  ingress {
    from_port       = 0
    to_port         = 65535
    protocol        = "tcp"
    security_groups = [aws_security_group.alb.id]
    description     = "Traffic from ALB"
  }
  
  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

// RDS Security Group (PostgreSQL)
resource "aws_security_group" "rds" {
  name        = "jibonflow-rds-sg"
  description = "Allow PostgreSQL from ECS tasks"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.jibonflow_production.id
  
  ingress {
    from_port       = 5432
    to_port         = 5432
    protocol        = "tcp"
    security_groups = [aws_security_group.ecs_tasks.id]
    description     = "PostgreSQL from ECS"
  }
}

// ElastiCache Security Group (Redis)
resource "aws_security_group" "elasticache" {
  name        = "jibonflow-elasticache-sg"
  description = "Allow Redis from ECS tasks"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.jibonflow_production.id
  
  ingress {
    from_port       = 6379
    to_port         = 6379
    protocol        = "tcp"
    security_groups = [aws_security_group.ecs_tasks.id]
    description     = "Redis from ECS"
  }
}
```

## 4. RDS Multi-AZ Configuration

### 4.1 PostgreSQL Configuration

```typescript
// infra/terraform/rds.tf
resource "aws_db_subnet_group" "jibonflow" {
  name       = "jibonflow-db-subnet-group"
  subnet_ids = aws_subnet.data[*].id
  
  tags = {
    Name = "jibonflow-db-subnet-group"
  }
}

resource "aws_db_instance" "postgres" {
  identifier     = "jibonflow-production-db"
  engine         = "postgres"
  engine_version = "15.4"
  instance_class = "db.r6g.xlarge" // 4 vCPU, 32 GB RAM
  
  // Multi-AZ Configuration
  multi_az               = true  // ✅ Automatic failover to standby
  availability_zone      = "ap-southeast-1a"
  backup_retention_period = 30   // 30 days (HIPAA requirement)
  backup_window          = "03:00-04:00" // 3-4 AM SGT (low traffic)
  maintenance_window     = "sun:04:00-sun:05:00"
  
  // Storage
  allocated_storage     = 500 // GB (SSD)
  max_allocated_storage = 2000 // Auto-scaling up to 2 TB
  storage_type          = "gp3"
  storage_encrypted     = true  // ✅ HIPAA requirement
  kms_key_id            = aws_kms_key.rds.arn
  
  // Database
  db_name  = "jibonflow_production"
  username = "jibonflow_admin"
  password = data.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.db_password.secret_string
  
  // Networking
  db_subnet_group_name   = aws_db_subnet_group.jibonflow.name
  vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.rds.id]
  publicly_accessible    = false
  
  // Performance Insights (for monitoring)
  enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports = ["postgresql", "upgrade"]
  performance_insights_enabled    = true
  performance_insights_retention_period = 7
  
  // Deletion Protection
  deletion_protection = true
  skip_final_snapshot = false
  final_snapshot_identifier = "jibonflow-final-snapshot"
  
  tags = {
    Name        = "jibonflow-production-db"
    Environment = "production"
    HIPAA       = "true"
  }
}

// Read Replicas (for read-heavy workloads)
resource "aws_db_instance" "postgres_read_replica" {
  count              = 2
  identifier         = "jibonflow-production-db-replica-${count.index + 1}"
  replicate_source_db = aws_db_instance.postgres.identifier
  instance_class     = "db.r6g.large" // Smaller than primary
  
  availability_zone  = var.availability_zones[count.index]
  storage_encrypted  = true
  kms_key_id         = aws_kms_key.rds.arn
  
  publicly_accessible = false
  
  tags = {
    Name = "jibonflow-read-replica-${count.index + 1}"
    Type = "read-replica"
  }
}
```

### 4.2 RDS Failover Behavior

| Scenario | Behavior | RTO | RPO |
|----------|----------|-----|-----|
| **Primary AZ Failure** | Automatic DNS failover to standby | 60-120s | 0 (synchronous replication) |
| **Database Crash** | Auto-restart on same AZ | 5-10s | 0 |
| **Storage Failure** | Failover to standby (different AZ) | 60-120s | 0 |
| **Network Partition** | Health check detects, triggers failover | 60s | 0 |

## 5. ElastiCache Multi-AZ Configuration

### 5.1 Redis Cluster Mode

```typescript
// infra/terraform/elasticache.tf
resource "aws_elasticache_subnet_group" "jibonflow" {
  name       = "jibonflow-cache-subnet-group"
  subnet_ids = aws_subnet.data[*].id
}

resource "aws_elasticache_replication_group" "redis" {
  replication_group_id       = "jibonflow-redis-cluster"
  replication_group_description = "JibonFlow Redis cluster with automatic failover"
  
  // Engine
  engine               = "redis"
  engine_version       = "7.0"
  node_type            = "cache.r6g.large" // 2 vCPU, 13.07 GB RAM
  num_cache_clusters   = 2 // 1 primary + 1 replica
  
  // Multi-AZ with Automatic Failover
  automatic_failover_enabled = true  // ✅ Auto-promote replica to primary
  multi_az_enabled           = true
  
  // Networking
  subnet_group_name    = aws_elasticache_subnet_group.jibonflow.name
  security_group_ids   = [aws_security_group.elasticache.id]
  
  // Persistence (for PHI caching)
  at_rest_encryption_enabled = true
  transit_encryption_enabled = true
  auth_token_enabled         = true
  kms_key_id                 = aws_kms_key.elasticache.arn
  
  // Backups
  snapshot_retention_limit   = 7 // 7 days
  snapshot_window            = "03:00-04:00"
  maintenance_window         = "sun:04:00-sun:05:00"
  
  // Cluster Mode (for horizontal scaling)
  cluster_mode {
    num_node_groups         = 2  // 2 shards
    replicas_per_node_group = 1  // 1 replica per shard
  }
  
  // Parameter Group (custom tuning)
  parameter_group_name = aws_elasticache_parameter_group.redis.name
  
  tags = {
    Name        = "jibonflow-redis-cluster"
    Environment = "production"
    HIPAA       = "true"
  }
}

resource "aws_elasticache_parameter_group" "redis" {
  name   = "jibonflow-redis-params"
  family = "redis7"
  
  parameter {
    name  = "maxmemory-policy"
    value = "allkeys-lru" // Evict least recently used keys when memory full
  }
  
  parameter {
    name  = "timeout"
    value = "300" // Close idle connections after 5 minutes
  }
}
```

### 5.2 Redis Failover Behavior

| Scenario | Behavior | RTO | RPO |
|----------|----------|-----|-----|
| **Primary Node Failure** | Auto-promote replica to primary | 30-60s | <5s (async replication) |
| **AZ Failure** | Failover to replica in different AZ | 30-60s | <5s |
| **Network Partition** | Sentinel detects, triggers promotion | 30s | <5s |

## 6. ECS Fargate Multi-AZ Deployment

### 6.1 ECS Cluster Configuration

```typescript
// infra/terraform/ecs.tf
resource "aws_ecs_cluster" "jibonflow" {
  name = "jibonflow-production-cluster"
  
  setting {
    name  = "containerInsights"
    value = "enabled" // CloudWatch Container Insights
  }
  
  tags = {
    Name        = "jibonflow-production-cluster"
    Environment = "production"
  }
}

resource "aws_ecs_cluster_capacity_providers" "jibonflow" {
  cluster_name = aws_ecs_cluster.jibonflow.name
  
  capacity_providers = ["FARGATE", "FARGATE_SPOT"]
  
  default_capacity_provider_strategy {
    capacity_provider = "FARGATE"
    weight            = 3
    base              = 2
  }
  
  default_capacity_provider_strategy {
    capacity_provider = "FARGATE_SPOT"
    weight            = 1
  }
}
```

### 6.2 ECS Service (auth-service example)

```typescript
resource "aws_ecs_service" "auth_service" {
  name            = "auth-service"
  cluster         = aws_ecs_cluster.jibonflow.id
  task_definition = aws_ecs_task_definition.auth_service.arn
  desired_count   = 4 // 2 tasks per AZ
  
  // Multi-AZ Deployment
  network_configuration {
    subnets          = aws_subnet.private[*].id
    security_groups  = [aws_security_group.ecs_tasks.id]
    assign_public_ip = false
  }
  
  // Load Balancer Integration
  load_balancer {
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.auth_service.arn
    container_name   = "auth-service"
    container_port   = 3000
  }
  
  // Service Auto Scaling
  deployment_configuration {
    maximum_percent         = 200 // Allow 2x tasks during deployment
    minimum_healthy_percent = 50  // Keep at least 50% healthy
  }
  
  // Health Checks
  health_check_grace_period_seconds = 60
  
  // Auto-distribute across AZs
  ordered_placement_strategy {
    type  = "spread"
    field = "attribute:ecs.availability-zone"
  }
  
  ordered_placement_strategy {
    type  = "spread"
    field = "instanceId"
  }
  
  tags = {
    Name        = "auth-service"
    Environment = "production"
  }
}

// Auto Scaling (CPU/Memory based)
resource "aws_appautoscaling_target" "auth_service" {
  max_capacity       = 20  // Max 20 tasks total
  min_capacity       = 4   // Min 4 tasks (2 per AZ)
  resource_id        = "service/${aws_ecs_cluster.jibonflow.name}/${aws_ecs_service.auth_service.name}"
  scalable_dimension = "ecs:service:DesiredCount"
  service_namespace  = "ecs"
}

resource "aws_appautoscaling_policy" "auth_service_cpu" {
  name               = "auth-service-cpu-scaling"
  policy_type        = "TargetTrackingScaling"
  resource_id        = aws_appautoscaling_target.auth_service.resource_id
  scalable_dimension = aws_appautoscaling_target.auth_service.scalable_dimension
  service_namespace  = aws_appautoscaling_target.auth_service.service_namespace
  
  target_tracking_scaling_policy_configuration {
    target_value       = 70.0 // Scale when CPU > 70%
    predefined_metric_specification {
      predefined_metric_type = "ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization"
    }
    scale_in_cooldown  = 300  // 5 minutes
    scale_out_cooldown = 60   // 1 minute
  }
}
```

## 7. Application Load Balancer (ALB)

### 7.1 ALB Configuration

```typescript
// infra/terraform/alb.tf
resource "aws_lb" "jibonflow" {
  name               = "jibonflow-production-alb"
  internal           = false
  load_balancer_type = "application"
  security_groups    = [aws_security_group.alb.id]
  subnets            = aws_subnet.public[*].id
  
  enable_deletion_protection = true
  enable_http2               = true
  enable_cross_zone_load_balancing = true
  
  // Access Logs (HIPAA compliance)
  access_logs {
    bucket  = aws_s3_bucket.alb_logs.bucket
    prefix  = "alb-logs"
    enabled = true
  }
  
  tags = {
    Name        = "jibonflow-production-alb"
    Environment = "production"
  }
}

// HTTPS Listener
resource "aws_lb_listener" "https" {
  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.jibonflow.arn
  port              = 443
  protocol          = "HTTPS"
  ssl_policy        = "ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01"
  certificate_arn   = aws_acm_certificate.jibonflow.arn
  
  default_action {
    type = "fixed-response"
    fixed_response {
      content_type = "text/plain"
      message_body = "Service Unavailable"
      status_code  = "503"
    }
  }
}

// Target Group (auth-service)
resource "aws_lb_target_group" "auth_service" {
  name        = "auth-service-tg"
  port        = 3000
  protocol    = "HTTP"
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.jibonflow_production.id
  target_type = "ip" // For Fargate
  
  health_check {
    enabled             = true
    path                = "/health"
    protocol            = "HTTP"
    interval            = 30
    timeout             = 5
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 3
    matcher             = "200"
  }
  
  deregistration_delay = 30 // Drain connections for 30s
  
  stickiness {
    type            = "lb_cookie"
    cookie_duration = 86400 // 24 hours
    enabled         = true
  }
}

// Listener Rule (route /api/auth/* to auth-service)
resource "aws_lb_listener_rule" "auth_service" {
  listener_arn = aws_lb_listener.https.arn
  priority     = 100
  
  action {
    type             = "forward"
    target_group_arn = aws_lb_target_group.auth_service.arn
  }
  
  condition {
    path_pattern {
      values = ["/api/auth/*"]
    }
  }
}
```

## 8. Disaster Recovery & Backups

### 8.1 Backup Strategy

| Resource | Backup Method | Frequency | Retention | RTO | RPO |
|----------|---------------|-----------|-----------|-----|-----|
| **RDS PostgreSQL** | Automated snapshots | Daily | 30 days | <15 min | <24 hours |
| **Redis (ElastiCache)** | Automated snapshots | Daily | 7 days | <5 min | <24 hours |
| **S3 (PHI Files)** | Cross-region replication | Real-time | Indefinite | <1 min | <1 min |
| **ECS Task Definitions** | Terraform state (S3) | On change | Indefinite | <5 min | 0 |

### 8.2 Disaster Recovery Runbook

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Disaster Recovery Script: Full Region Failover

# 1. Restore RDS from latest snapshot
aws rds restore-db-instance-from-db-snapshot \
  --db-instance-identifier jibonflow-dr-db \
  --db-snapshot-identifier jibonflow-production-db-2025-10-11 \
  --multi-az

# 2. Restore ElastiCache from snapshot
aws elasticache create-replication-group \
  --replication-group-id jibonflow-dr-redis \
  --snapshot-name jibonflow-redis-2025-10-11

# 3. Update DNS to point to new ALB
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets \
  --hosted-zone-id Z1234567890ABC \
  --change-batch file://dns-failover.json

# 4. Redeploy ECS services in new region
terraform init
terraform plan -var="region=ap-southeast-2"
terraform apply -auto-approve

# Total RTO: ~15 minutes
```

## 9. Monitoring & Alerting

### 9.1 CloudWatch Alarms

```typescript
// High CPU Utilization (ECS Tasks)
resource "aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm" "ecs_cpu_high" {
  alarm_name          = "jibonflow-ecs-cpu-high"
  comparison_operator = "GreaterThanThreshold"
  evaluation_periods  = 2
  metric_name         = "CPUUtilization"
  namespace           = "AWS/ECS"
  period              = 300
  statistic           = "Average"
  threshold           = 80
  alarm_description   = "ECS tasks CPU > 80%"
  alarm_actions       = [aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn]
  
  dimensions = {
    ClusterName = aws_ecs_cluster.jibonflow.name
  }
}

// RDS Failover Detected
resource "aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm" "rds_failover" {
  alarm_name          = "jibonflow-rds-failover"
  comparison_operator = "GreaterThanThreshold"
  evaluation_periods  = 1
  metric_name         = "FailoverCount"
  namespace           = "AWS/RDS"
  period              = 60
  statistic           = "Sum"
  threshold           = 0
  alarm_description   = "RDS Multi-AZ failover detected"
  alarm_actions       = [aws_sns_topic.critical_alerts.arn]
  
  dimensions = {
    DBInstanceIdentifier = aws_db_instance.postgres.id
  }
}

// ALB Target Health (Unhealthy Targets)
resource "aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm" "alb_unhealthy_targets" {
  alarm_name          = "jibonflow-alb-unhealthy-targets"
  comparison_operator = "GreaterThanThreshold"
  evaluation_periods  = 2
  metric_name         = "UnHealthyHostCount"
  namespace           = "AWS/ApplicationELB"
  period              = 60
  statistic           = "Average"
  threshold           = 0
  alarm_description   = "ALB has unhealthy targets"
  alarm_actions       = [aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn]
  
  dimensions = {
    LoadBalancer = aws_lb.jibonflow.arn_suffix
  }
}
```

## 10. Cost Estimation

## 11. Implementation Checklist

- [ ] Provision VPC with 3-tier subnet architecture (public, private, data)
- [ ] Deploy NAT Gateways in each AZ
- [ ] Configure security groups (ALB, ECS, RDS, ElastiCache)
- [ ] Deploy RDS PostgreSQL with Multi-AZ enabled
- [ ] Deploy ElastiCache Redis with automatic failover
- [ ] Create ECS cluster and deploy services across AZs
- [ ] Configure Application Load Balancer with HTTPS
- [ ] Set up Route 53 health checks and DNS failover
- [ ] Enable CloudWatch alarms for all critical resources
- [ ] Configure S3 cross-region replication for PHI files
- [ ] Test failover scenarios (RDS, Redis, ECS, ALB)
- [ ] Document disaster recovery runbook
- [ ] Conduct DR drill (simulate AZ failure)
